Highest-value finding is the SSO restore-session token-drop on transient network error (offline cold launch forces sign-out).

evidence: mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/auth/SsoService.kt:318 — restoreSession() calls getSession(); any getSession failure (onFailure) nulls sessionToken and sets Unauthenticated, but getSession catches transient network exceptions (line 107-109) the same as 401. A cold app launch while offline therefore discards the restored session and forces the user signed-out, instead of distinguishing an auth failure (401 -> logout) from a recoverable network error.

mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/api/ApiClient.kt — ApiClient has no test file (its only appearance in commonTest is a code comment in ListingDetailRepositoryTest.kt); it attaches the Authorization: Bearer token and X-Tenant-ID isolation header and has reachable, untested error-mapping branches (Unauthorized -> 'Please sign in', Conflict -> 'Already in favorites', NotFound) for getListings/getListing/getFavorites/addFavorite/removeFavorite/submitInquiry — an auth/tenant-carrying network core with untested Unauthorized handling.

mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/ui/listing/ListingDetailScreen.kt:115 — onCallClick lambda re-reads `state.listing!!` (state is a collectAsState()-backed StateFlow value) at click time rather than capturing the render-time snapshot; if the VM state emits listing=null between render and the deferred click, the non-null assertion throws NPE. Same latent double-read pattern in FavoritesScreen.kt:164 and InquiriesScreen.kt:169 (`errorMessage!!`).

mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/util/NetworkError.kt — the isNetworkError() error-classification heuristic (exception-name matching, message-hint matching, and the cause-chain walk with its self-reference guard `it !== cause`) is referenced by no test in commonTest; the UI relies on it to swap technical exceptions for friendly copy, so every mapping branch is unverified.

mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/inquiry/InquiryRepository.kt — its only test (InquiryRepositoryPathEncodingTest.kt) asserts path percent-encoding only; the Unauthorized ('Please sign in...') and NotFound ('Inquiry not found') error-mapping branches across getInquiries/getRealtorInquiries/getInquiry/replyToInquiry/getViewings/cancelViewing are exercised by no test.
